content:
**Rapidan Camp** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

Rapidan Camp was constructed in 1929 by former president Herbert Hoover and his wife Lou as their personal retreat during his presidency. [1] [2] [3] The camp was built along the Rapidan River due to Herbert's love of fishing, and the Trout Pond was dug by US Marines so that Herbert would have a place to display the fish he caught. [4] Herbert and Lou were the first to stay at the Brown House, and after Herbert's presidency was over he donated the camp to the executive branch of the United States government for future presidents to enjoy. [5] It served as the retreat for numerous presidents, and has been visited by multiple prime ministers of Great Britain. [6] 

Prior to the Great War, multiple events were planned for the coming months. Employees working at Rapidan Camp were invited to attend the annual Halloween celebrations held at the Shenandoah Visitor Center. [7] The camp was expecting another dignitary to be hosted by the President from November 16th to the 18th. This guest would have stayed in the Prime Minister's Cabin, and in anticipation for their arrival the kitchen was stocked with their favorite brand of tea in the loose variety. [8] [9] On December 23rd, the Secretary of the Interior was set to visit the camp for their quarterly visit and elected to stay at the camp over the course of the Christmas holiday. [10] The last event scheduled for the year was a New Year's party which was sponsored by Stolz Enterprises, at which Hugo and Cassidy Stolz would give speeches. The Secretary of the Interior was also set to make an announcement regarding the future of Shenandoah National Park. [11]
